title: Pixel sparkle ink ripple across live cards
blurb: Tap anywhere on a Material You card surface inside one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas to launch up to four concurrent quantum sparkle ink ripples across live buttons, switches and typed text without overflow: hidden clipping.
question: Can one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas burst up to four concurrent Pixel-style quantum sparkle ink ripples from exact tap coordinates across live Material buttons, switches and an editable input while illuminating edges sampled from texElementSubImage2D()?
result: Measured in headless Chrome 160 Canary (2026-11-27, 412 px, 2.625 DPR): 6/6 live checks pass, 0.99 MP (937x1057 px) on one ElementGL context, ring luminance rises +109.4 max, 4-ripple overlap returns to 0 post-completion delta, and elementsFromPoint() hits live buttons and the input. Chromium 157, check:jank and Chrome 159 on Android stay not verified.
